description: A React component implementing a login and registration page with password reset functionality, including form handling, validation, API calls, and UI state management.

methods.name: getNextAuthErrorMessage
methods.description: Maps error codes from NextAuth to user-friendly error messages.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles user login by calling login API, managing errors, and redirecting based on user role.

methods.name: handleSignupStep1
methods.description: Validates signup form data and proceeds to password creation step.

methods.name: handleSignup
methods.description: Submits registration data, handles server responses, and manages errors.

methods.name: selectEmail
methods.description: Selects an email from saved emails for autofill.

methods.name: handleForgotPassword
methods.description: Initiates password reset process by sending reset email or token.

methods.name: handleResetPassword
methods.description: Completes password reset using provided token and new password.
